title: SWF: ActionScript debugger bytecode (ActionTrace)
description: ActionTrace is the AS2 trace() function output. In AVM1, trace(msg) calls ActionTrace (0x26). Verify that trace('hello') in AS2 compiles to ActionTrace. Check packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts for trace() call handling. Also verify: _root, _parent, _global compile to ActionGetVariable with those names. Add tests for trace(), _root access, _parent access in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/builtins.test.ts.
